title: Chapter 1381 - 5: Lin Yuan And Gray Ancestor
content:
Chapter 1381 - 5: Lin Yuan And Gray Ancestor

Chapter 1381: Chapter 5: Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor

This time, Lin Yuan was extremely relaxed, with the support of a lord’s position, the Gray Ancestor, a Second Realm time being, found it very difficult to glimpse his traces.

Meanwhile, he observed Gray Ancestor’s schemes from a distance.

"This time, I can see the true methods of a Second Realm time being."

Lin Yuan felt quite anticipatory.

Although he had ample foundational resources, he had just entered the thirteenth level, even having seen countless future timelines.

He still needed to engage in real combat.

When watching future timelines, Lin Yuan was in an absolute ’God’s perspective’.

Unable to directly feel the pressure from his enemies.

"This Gray Ancestor is quite suitable as my whetstone."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

"And who are you?"

Gray Ancestor was also observing Lin Yuan, his expression solemn and serious.

He did not detect Lin Yuan’s appearance in the observed future timelines.

This meant that the mysterious time being suddenly appearing had surpassed him in the aspect of time-line concealment.

Otherwise, he wouldn’t be so unaware.

"Where did this strong being emerge from?"

Gray Ancestor felt this was tricky, realizing Lin Yuan’s time line hadn’t been blocked yet, meant the opponent was most likely at the same Second Realm time life level as him.

He did not dare to remain standing there.

Facing a life of the same realm, Gray Ancestor was relatively confident.

Compared to Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor’s confrontation.

The distant watching time beings were engulfed in turbulent waves of astonishment.

"This...this..."

"What’s happening? Who exactly are the two of them?"

"I haven’t seen these two in the future timelines."

"Second Realm time beings, these two are very likely both Second Realm time beings."

"How can this be? Just a single Heart of Heavenly River attracted two Second Realm time beings?"

The time beings watching rapidly exchanged thoughts, if Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor hadn’t revealed themselves, they might have continued to be fooled.

But since they showed up, the many vague, twisted timelines gradually became clear.

Coupled with the watching time beings detecting the difficulty in directly viewing Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor’s timelines.

They immediately speculated plenty.

"The Heart of Heavenly River, this time, the nurturing Heart of Heavenly River is extraordinary."

"I have already contacted ’Mother of the Screw Realm.’

’Mother of the Screw Realm’ is one of the Second Realm time beings in this vast dimensional gap area.

Many time beings in the Milky Way realm have a good relationship with ’Mother of the Screw Realm,’ upon seeing two unfamiliar Second Realm time beings appearing, they definitely inform ’Mother of the Screw Realm’ first.

"Mother of the Screw Realm says she is aware here, and advises us not to approach."

A time being said.

Others nodded in agreement.

In facing the confrontation of the suspected Second Realm time beings, they wouldn’t go near, attempting any ’capitalizing’ actions.

Second Realm time beings have grasp and vision over future timelines, able to suppress those of the First Realm.

Many things they just started to envision, the Second Realm beings had already sensed specific futures.

When the confrontation between the two Second Realm time beings likely pauses, they might turn against them in clearing the space.

...

"Luckily the Galaxy appeared in time."

Lord Mo Xu stabilized his heart, even possessing Rune Jade Stone that could suppress the Master of Taixu.

But in facing a Second Realm time being, defeat would eventually come, without much significance.

Just as Gray Ancestor emerged, the aura he exuded slightly suppressed the Rune Jade Stone field, proving this.

"Galaxy..."

Lord Mo Xu observed Lin Yuan beside him, in the chaos void, he couldn’t sense it.

Just here, to resist Gray Ancestor, Lin Yuan revealed a bit of his aura, even without targeting him, Lord Mo Xu bore great pressure.

This pressure might seem trivial to other time beings’ eyes, for the Second Realm naturally outmatched the First Realm.

But Lord Mo Xu knew, Lin Yuan crossed into the thirteenth level just not long ago, yet now his strength elevated to such extent?

The pressure not only sourced from physical soul, but also from mental thoughts... as well as shock.

...

"Did the chaos void also fetch a Second Realm time being?"

The Master of Taixu glanced at Lin Yuan standing beside Lord Mo Xu, surprised.

"Was it deliberate to keep me uninformed, or..."

The Master smiled slightly at the Gray Ancestor donned in a gray cloak.

If he had known beforehand about needing to face a Second Realm time being for the Heart of Heavenly River.

He definitely wouldn’t have easily agreed to the dealings with Gray Ancestor.

Feuding with a First Realm time being versus one of Second Realm.

Completely different scenarios.

The latter entails costs far exceeding the former.

Even if the Second Realm being fails to outmatch Gray Ancestor.

They wouldn’t be able to tackle Gray Ancestor, let alone them, the group of First Realm time beings?

Though having the shelter of Taixu Dimension ensures survival isn’t an issue.

But with a Second Realm time being orchestrating in the darkness, the Taixu realm hosting these time beings might not dare venture into the dimensional rift again.

...

Gray Ancestor gazed from a distance at Lin Yuan, speaking: "Your method of concealing your timeline is impressive, is it leveraged through some kind of secret technique heritage, or external peculiar treasures?"

Though not a Time Lord, he still covered his timeline to such a degree.

Gray Ancestor naturally assumed Lin Yuan relied on external powers.

In the expansive dimensional rift, countless peculiar treasures were nurtured, some having timeline concealment effects.
